auth_note: Tallies endpoint answered anonymously; other endpoints need a token (self-service API keys exist, per the OpenAPI description).
rate_limit: Without an Authentication Token: up to 10 requests per second, up to 40 requests per minute; tallies and papers endpoints are uncapped (docs). Probe response headers showed X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute 60.
probe_observation: GET /tallies/10.1038/nature12373 returned JSON starting {"total":1930,"supporting":22,... with doi and citingPublications 2153, no credentials sent.

evidence.quote: Scite Endpoints require tokens in order to be used (aside from tallies and papers endpoints).
Without an Authentication Token, the default rate limit is up to 10 requests per second, up to 40 requests per minute.

not_established: Cost/pricing of tokens not found (scite.ai/api returned CloudFront 403 from this sandbox; OpenAPI says contact sales@scite.ai or use self-service keys, prices not stated). Data license not found in the OpenAPI doc (only a link to https://scite.ai/terms, not captured). Docs page api.scite.ai/docs is a JS shell (docs.txt is 14 bytes), so the OpenAPI JSON was used instead. No bulk route documented. Documented 40/min differs from the 60/min header observed on the probe.
